blockingIssues.description: cargo clippy --workspace -- -D warnings fails with 44+ collapsible_if errors in katla_ecs/src/query/ (iter3.rs through iter8.rs) and 5 collapsible_if errors in katla_ui. The edition 2024 upgrade enables let_chains, making clippy enforce collapsing nested if-let statements. katla_ecs has deeply nested if-let chains in query iterators (iter3-iter8) that need to be collapsed using let chains (if let X && let Y pattern). katla_ui has 5 instances across drawing.rs, popup/internal.rs, widgets/graph.rs, and widgets.rs.
blockingIssues.suggestedFix: Collapse nested if-let statements in katla_ecs query iterators (iter3-iter8) and katla_ui files using let chains syntax (if let ... && let ...). This is a straightforward mechanical fix enabled by edition 2024's let_chains feature.

nonBlockingIssues.description: Unused import warnings remain in katla_app/src/systems/culling_system.rs (unused AABB import), katla_app/src/systems/particle_system.rs (unused super::* import), and katla_app/src/systems/rendering/lighting_system_tests.rs (unused SpotLight import). These are warnings only (not errors with -D warnings), but suggest incomplete cleanup.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add to coding conventions: When upgrading Rust edition, always run cargo clippy --workspace -- -D warnings after edition changes. The 2024 edition enables let_chains which makes clippy enforce collapsible_if on nested if-let statements — ensure all nested if-let chains are collapsed before completing.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: foundation-edition-upgrade upgraded to edition 2024 but did not collapse nested if-let chains in katla_ecs query iterators or katla_ui, causing 49 clippy errors.

lintErrorDetails.rootCause: Edition 2024 upgrade enables let_chains feature, making clippy's collapsible_if lint trigger on nested if-let statements that can now be collapsed using let chain syntax (if let X && let Y { ... })
